summary: GRAVEYARD causal pass mapped every b03 company to its principal 2036 constraint chain and explicit falsifier. These are lane opinions only; no canonical causal graph mutation is attempted. Future uncertainty is preserved as falsifiers rather than incorrectly treated as present evidence gaps.

materialFindings.chain: AI/advanced compute need -> semiconductor complexity -> test intensity/yield -> automated test equipment -> TER
materialFindings.falsifier: test intensity per advanced device falls structurally or integrated/self-test architectures materially displace external ATE economics
materialFindings.evidence: TER 2025 10-K shows semiconductor-test exposure and concentrated Asian production geography.

materialFindings.chain: labor/energy scarcity -> factory productivity -> industrial automation/control -> ROK
materialFindings.falsifier: open software/control commoditizes proprietary automation economics faster than installed-base/service leverage compounds

materialFindings.chain: road safety/labor efficiency -> ADAS/autonomy -> perception+mapping+compute stack -> MBLY
materialFindings.falsifier: OEM vertical integration or alternate end-to-end stacks erase Mobileye attach-rate/design-win economics
materialFindings.evidence: FY2025 SEC-filed results disclose new high-volume Surround ADAS win and Volkswagen robotaxi roadmap.

materialFindings.chain: last-mile labor cost -> sidewalk delivery automation -> fleet utilization/platform access -> SERV
materialFindings.falsifier: unit economics fail at scaled utilization or platform concentration prevents durable take-rate power
materialFindings.evidence: SEC filing documents historical Uber concentration at 71% of 2023 revenue.

materialFindings.chain: trucking labor/safety -> autonomous highway freight -> certified driverless stack+OEM/logistics integration -> AUR
materialFindings.falsifier: certification/regulatory throughput or safety-case scaling lags technical capability enough to prevent fleet economics
materialFindings.evidence: 2026 Q2 SEC-filed results show commercialization remains nascent with $3m six-month revenue.

materialFindings.chain: electrification+AI load -> power quality/distribution scarcity -> switchgear/power management -> ETN
materialFindings.falsifier: grid/data-center capex normalizes while supply expands enough to eliminate electrical-equipment scarcity rents
materialFindings.evidence: 2026 primary release identifies data center and utility markets and strong backlog/order growth.

materialFindings.chain: load growth+renewables -> transmission/grid build -> skilled engineering/construction capacity -> PWR
materialFindings.falsifier: permitting/interconnection reform fails to translate into funded construction or utility capex structurally retrenches

materialFindings.chain: AI/LNG/industrial electrification -> medium-voltage distribution -> engineered switchgear/control -> POWL
materialFindings.falsifier: project mix commoditizes or manufacturing capacity expansion causes engineered-switchgear margins/backlog to mean-revert sharply
materialFindings.evidence: Q1 FY2026 primary filing reports $1.6bn backlog, first data-center megaproject order and large LNG award.

materialFindings.chain: 24/7 low-carbon electricity need -> firm nuclear generation -> scarce existing nuclear fleet/interconnection -> CEG
materialFindings.falsifier: large-load contracts fail to monetize nuclear scarcity or regulatory/political constraints overwhelm fleet economics

materialFindings.chain: AI/load growth -> firm dispatchable power+capacity -> nuclear/gas generation and retail integration -> VST
materialFindings.falsifier: power-market scarcity collapses from rapid supply/transmission build or hedging/contract structure prevents capture

materialFindings.chain: grid-constrained data-center power -> behind-the-meter firm generation -> solid-oxide fuel cells -> BE
materialFindings.falsifier: gas/emissions economics, reliability, or competing turbines/storage/grid interconnect erase time-to-power advantage

materialFindings.chain: firm clean power need -> new nuclear capacity -> factory/modular reactor deployment -> SMR
materialFindings.falsifier: first-of-a-kind cost, licensing, financing or customer commitment prevents repeatable commercial deployment
materialFindings.evidence: FY2025 primary results show $31.5m revenue, $459.6m operating cash use and heavy equity financing, confirming commercialization/financing as live constraints.

unknowns: Relative 2036 market shares are unknowable and are not fabricated.
For ROK/PWR/CEG/VST/BE, current issuer-primary underwriting detail is still needed by the underwriting lane; that does not prevent defining testable causal chains/falsifiers.
peerRequests: Adversarial-red-team: attack ETN/POWL/CEG/VST/BE power-scarcity thesis for common-factor crowding and substitution.
Discovery lane: test autonomy certification throughput as a distinct constraint for AUR/MBLY/SERV.
